outcomes: Demonstrate mastery of a broad set of chemical knowledge concerning the fundamentals of general and organic chemistry.
When presented with a specific problem, formulate a strategy for solving the problem, apply appropriate techniques to arrive at a solution, and interpret their results.
Know and follow the proper procedures and regulations for safe handling and use of chemicals.
Demonstrate an understanding of the objective of chemical experiments, properly carry out the experiments, appropriately record and analyze data, and draw meaningful conclusions based on the results.
Use standard laboratory equipment, modern instrumentation (including computers for data acquisition), and classical techniques to carry out experiments.
Communicate the concepts and results of laboratory experiments through effective writing and/or oral communication using the discipline standards for reporting and citation.

Use modern library search tools to locate and retrieve scientific information about a topic, chemical, chemical technique, or an issue relating to chemistry, going beyond textbooks, common handbooks, and general online resources such as Wikipedia.
Collaborate effectively as part of a team to solve problems, debate different points of view, and interact productively with a diverse group of team members.
